title: Canonical index under an extending restriction
statement: Let $\phi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates, and let $\rho,\eta$ be coordinate restrictions such that $\eta$ agrees with $\rho$ wherever $\rho$ is fixed. Suppose each restriction admits at least one compatible term, and the term of least index compatible with $\rho$ is also compatible with $\eta$. Then the least index of a term compatible with $\eta$ equals the least index of a term compatible with $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF formula on n coordinates
Each of ρ and η has a compatible term
η agrees with ρ at every coordinate where ρ is not free
The canonical term chosen for ρ is compatible with η
